package.name: manriix_bi3d_overlay
package.description:
Workspace overlay for NVIDIA isaac_ros_bi3d. Installs a modified bi3d_node.yaml that increases the DLA inference memory pool block_size from 2211840 to 15000000 to handle our 960x576 image resolution with full disparity output.
Why: The apt-installed bi3d_node.yaml has a hardcoded block_size that's too small. NVIDIA GitHub issue: https://github.com/NVIDIA-ISAAC-ROS/isaac_ros_freespace_segmentation/issues/6
By installing our copy into share/isaac_ros_bi3d/, it overrides the /opt version via AMENT_PREFIX_PATH precedence. The /opt files are NOT modified.
